name: Making The Right Decision
overview: Scripture teaches that making the right decision requires trusting the Lord wholeheartedly rather than relying on our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 emphasizes. God promises to guide and instruct us personally, watching over our paths (Psalms 32:8), while wisdom, knowledge, and understanding come directly from Him (Proverbs 2:6). Additionally, seeking counsel is vital, for without it people fall, but with many advisors there is safety (Proverbs 11:14), and listening to wise counsel distinguishes the prudent from the fool who trusts only his own judgment (Proverbs 12:15). Ultimately, what may seem right to man can lead to death, underscoring the necessity of divine guidance in all decisions (Proverbs 14:12).
